verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own Auto Drafts 2.0 is documented as able to 'insert availability' into reply drafts using calendar context, and its scheduling features can be instructed to 'use this booking link'. That is direct, product-native support for putting availability into an email, but it is evidenced only as one capability of AI-generated drafts, with no documented user-invoked availability-sharing workflow. Missing for 10: a dedicated user-triggered command to share or insert availability in a compose window, native bookable time slots or a booking page (the booking link appears to be user-supplied), details on how inserted times are chosen and formatted, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email

citations.quote: Auto Drafts now gather context from your inbox, your calendar, and the web. They can use information from other emails, insert availability, and conduct research online.
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
Each draft can use your inbox, calendar, and the web to write replies that are ready to send.
